description: The Farmland Irrigation Research Institute provides water-quality observations for six shallow groundwater sites and two flowing surface-water sites in Shangqiu, eastern Henan. Measurements span 2008–2020 and include temperature, pH and major dissolved ions such as calcium, magnesium, sodium and chloride. ScienceDB identifies the collection and assigns CC BY 4.0, enabling free reuse; the inspected top-level metadata does not specify file formats or sampling intervals. These observations can constrain irrigation-water chemistry and nutrient-transport simulations in the Huang-Huai Plain. Eight monitored sources provide local evidence, not a complete inventory of regional water supplies. The repository describes standard sample handling and analysis, but the underlying values were not independently checked. No directly related catalogue record was found.
name: Dataset on Water Quality Status of Farmland Irrigation Sources in Eastern Henan Region of the Huang-Huai Plain from 2008 to 2020
